description: Retrieve the most relevant lessons for a given tool/action context. Use in PreToolUse hooks for per-action guidance.

actionContext.description: Description of what the tool call is doing

filters.description: Pre-filter the candidate corpus before lexical or vector ranking.

includeRetrievalMeta.description: Include path provenance such as lexical/dense pools and query variants.

includeShared.description: Include explicitly shared memories with scoped results. Defaults true.

queryRewrite.description: Enable bounded deterministic synonym expansion when the original lexical match is weak. Defaults true.

requireScope.description: Fail closed unless a complete four-field scope is supplied.

toolName.description: The tool being called (e.g., Bash, Edit, Read)

name: retrieve_lessons
title: Retrieve Lessons
